Interface TaskRepository

All Superinterfaces:
org.springframework.data.repository.CrudRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListCrudRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.ListPagingAndSortingRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.PagingAndSortingRepository<Task,UUID>, org.springframework.data.repository.query.QueryByExampleExecutor<Task>, org.springframework.data.repository.Repository<Task,UUID>
@Repository public interface TaskRepository extends org.springframework.data.jpa.repository.JpaRepository<Task,UUID>
Spring Data JPA repository for Task (task table). Owned by the task module. Backs the task query use cases.

    • findByIdWithCreatedByAndProject

      @Query("SELECT t FROM Task t\nJOIN FETCH t.createdBy\nJOIN FETCH t.project\nWHERE t.taskId = :taskId\n") Optional<Task> findByIdWithCreatedByAndProject(@Param("taskId") UUID taskId)
      Loads task + creator + project for notification fan-out (avoids LazyInitializationException).

    • findByProject_ProjectId

      List<Task> findByProject_ProjectId(UUID projectId, org.springframework.data.domain.Sort sort)
      UC-09 Filter/Sort: tasks in a project, sorted per the caller's Sort. The Sort lets callers order by dueTime, priority, status, etc. without a bespoke query per ordering.

    • searchByKeyword

      @Query("select t from Task t\nwhere lower(t.name) like lower(concat('%', :keyword, '%'))\n or lower(t.description) like lower(concat('%', :keyword, '%'))\n or lower(t.comments) like lower(concat('%', :keyword, '%'))\n") List<Task> searchByKeyword(@Param("keyword") String keyword)
      UC-08 Search Tasks: case-insensitive keyword match over task name, description and comments. Parameterized (no string concatenation of user input) to prevent SQL injection.

      @Query("SELECT DISTINCT t.createdBy.username FROM Task t\nWHERE t.project.projectId = :projectId\nORDER BY t.createdBy.username\n") List<String> findDistinctCreatorUsernamesByProjectId(@Param("projectId") UUID projectId)
      Distinct users who created any task in a project.
